svg.title: Scrum master — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as scrum master, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A three-column task board has a header and separate tasks in different workflow positions. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
